# How many SNPs are on the Y chromosome?

This BED file contains coordinates for the scaffolds containing the Y chromosome.
```
scaffold_12    0        8700000
scaffold_13    0        26556177
scaffold_16    0        15407528
```

Let's check out the number of SNPs on my existing datasets.
```{bash, eval=FALSE} 
### how many SNPs are on the two pure Y scaffolds in the unfiltered SNP dataset?
grep -v "^#" /Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data-archive/unfiltered/populations.snps.vcf | \
    grep -E 'scaffold_13|scaffold_16' | \
    wc -l
#   32629

### how many total markers in 50% complete VCF?
gzcat /Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/pop-gen/full_miss50_snps.vcf.gz | \
    grep -v '^#' | wc -l
#   580058

gzcat /Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/pop-gen/full_miss50_snps.vcf.gz | grep -v '^#' | grep "scaffold_12" | wc -l
#   10428

gzcat /Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/pop-gen/full_miss50_snps.vcf.gz | grep -v '^#' | grep "scaffold_13" | wc -l
#   3647

gzcat /Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/pop-gen/full_miss50_snps.vcf.gz | grep -v '^#' | grep "scaffold_16" | wc -l

```

So, even with a less than ideal filtering scheme, we retain a substantial amount of data coming from the Y to infer evolutionary history. 

# Confirm males have Y chromosome data
I used samtools to quantify the number of reads and estimate the depth of coverage on the sex chromosome scaffolds to confirm morphological males as males/exclude females.
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=map-stats
#SBATCH --mem=96G
#SBATCH --time=60:00:00
#SBATCH --partition=nova_20
#SBATCH --output=out.stats_%j
#SBATCH --error=err.stats_%j

source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

BAM_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/alignments/AnoDist/bam/

STAT_FILE=mapping-stats.csv

echo -e "Specimen,Mapped Reads,Y-mapped reads,Avg. Depth,X1 Depth,X2 Depth,Y Depth" > $STAT_FILE

for BAM in "${BAM_DIR}"/*aligned.sorted.bam; do

        SAMPLE=$(basename "$BAM" .aligned.sorted.bam)
        echo "Processing $SAMPLE..."

        ### get mapped reads
        MAPPED_READS=$(samtools view -c -F 4 "$BAM")

        ## get Y mapped reads
        Y_READS=$(samtools view -c -F 4 -L y-chrom-scaffolds.txt "$BAM")

        ### estimate average depth of coverage
        AVG_DEPTH=$(samtools depth "$BAM" | awk '{sum+=$3} END {if (NR>0) print sum/NR; else print 0}')
        AVG_DEPTH=$(printf "%.2f" "$AVG_DEPTH")

        ### estimate average depth of coverage for X1 scaffold
        X1_DEPTH=$(samtools depth -r scaffold_8 "$BAM" | awk '{sum+=$3} END {if (NR>0) print sum/NR; else print 0}')
        X1_DEPTH=$(printf "%.2f" "$X1_DEPTH")

        ### estimate average depth of coverage for X2 scaffold
        X2_DEPTH=$(samtools depth -r scaffold_12:8700001-33619221 "$BAM" | awk '{sum+=$3} END {if (NR>0) print sum/NR; else print 0}')
        X2_DEPTH=$(printf "%.2f" "$X2_DEPTH")

        ### estimate average depth of coverage for Y scaffold
        Y_DEPTH=$(samtools depth -b y-chrom-scaffolds.txt "$BAM" | awk '{sum+=$3} END {if (NR>0) print sum/NR; else print 0}')
        Y_DEPTH=$(printf "%.2f" "$Y_DEPTH")

        ### append stats to file
        echo -e "${SAMPLE},${MAPPED_READS},${Y_READS},${AVG_DEPTH},${X1_DEPTH},${X2_DEPTH},${Y_DEPTH}" >> $STAT_FILE
        echo "Done with $SAMPLE"

done
```

```{r, fig.width = 24, fig.height = 8}
t.test(m_ratio, f_ratio)

    main = "Ratio of Y chromome reads/Total Mapped Reads")
hist(f_ratio, col=rgb(0,0,1,0.5), add=TRUE)

boxplot(m_ratio, f_ratio, names=c("M","F"))
```

The males have a greater proportion of Y-mapped reads than the females do so I will proceed with our sampling's sex identifications as is.

```{bash, eval = FALSE}

awk -F'\t' '$14=="m" && $7 !~ /^(caudalis|brevirostris|marron|websteri)$/ {print $2}' sampling-master-detailed.tsv > distichus_only_males.txt
```

## To maximize loci retention, filter specimens by missingness

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
VCF=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/populations.snps.sorted.vcf.gz
MALES=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/males.txt
Y_BED=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/y-chrom-scaffolds.txt
INDMISS=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/y_missingness_per_ind.txt

paste <(bcftools view -S $MALES --regions-file $Y_BED $VCF | \
bcftools query -f '[%SAMPLE\t]\n' | head -1 | tr '\t' '\n') <(bcftools view -S $MALES --regions-file $Y_BED $VCF | \
bcftools query -f '[%GT\t]\n' | awk -v OFS="\t" '{for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) if ($i == "./.") sum[i]+=1 } END {for (i in sum) print i, sum[i] / NR }' | sort -k1,1n | cut -f 2) > $INDMISS
```


# Redo data filtering for the Y chromosome with only males
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#! /usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --error=snpfilt_%j.err
#SBATCH --output=snpfilt_%j.out
#SBATCH --time=24:00:00
#SBATCH --job-name=YFilter

## Load conda env with bcftools
source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

VCF=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/populations.snps.sorted.vcf.gz
CLEAN=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/ychromosome_cleaned.vcf.gz
AD_CLEAN=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/ychromosome_cleaned_distichus_only.vcf.gz
OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools
Y_BED=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/y-chrom-scaffolds.txt
INDMISS=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/y_missingness_per_ind.txt
MALES=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/males.txt
AD_MALES=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/distichus_only_males.txt
VCF50=${OUT_DIR}/all_males_y_scaffolds_50miss.vcf.gz
VCF90=${OUT_DIR}/all_males_y_scaffolds_10miss.vcf.gz
AD50=${OUT_DIR}/distichus_males_y_scaffolds_50miss.vcf.gz
AD90=${OUT_DIR}/distichus_males_y_scaffolds_10miss.vcf.gz

paste \
<(bcftools view -S $MALES --regions-file $Y_BED $VCF | \
bcftools query -f '[%SAMPLE\t]\n' | head -1 | tr '\t' '\n') \
<(bcftools view -S $MALES --regions-file $Y_BED $VCF | \
bcftools query -f '[%GT\t]\n' | awk -v OFS="\t" '{for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) if ($i ~ /\./) sum[i]+=1 } END {for (i in sum) print i, sum[i] / NR }' | sort -k1,1n | cut -f 2) > $INDMISS

paste <(bcftools view -S $MALES --regions-file $Y_BED $VCF | \
    bcftools query -f '[%SAMPLE\t]\n' | \
    head -1 | \
    tr '\t' '\n') <(bcftools view -S $MALES --regions-file $Y_BED $VCF | \
    bcftools query -f '[%GT\t]\n' | \
    awk -v OFS="\t" '{for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) if ($i ~ /\./) sum[i]+=1 } END {for (i in sum) print i, sum[i] / NR }' | \
    sort -k1,1n | cut -f 2) | awk '{ if ($2 > 0.8) print $1 }' > specimens-to-exclude.txt
grep -Fvx -f specimens-to-exclude.txt $MALES > filtered-males.txt
grep -Fvx -f specimens-to-exclude.txt $AD_MALES > filtered-distichus-males.txt

### Drop specimens with >85% missing data
bcftools view -S filtered-males.txt --regions-file $Y_BED $VCF | bgzip > $CLEAN
bcftools index $CLEAN

bcftools view -S filtered-distichus-males.txt --regions-file $Y_BED $VCF | bgzip > $AD_CLEAN
bcftools index $AD_CLEAN

### Filter SNPs for depth, completeness (50%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools view -e 'FORMAT/DP > 72' $CLEAN | \
        bcftools view -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' | \
        bcftools view -e 'F_MISSING > 0.5' | \
        bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps | \
        bcftools sort -O z -o $VCF50
bcftools index $VCF50

### Filter SNPs for depth, completeness (90%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools view -e 'FORMAT/DP > 72' $CLEAN | \
        bcftools view -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' | \
        bcftools view -e 'F_MISSING > 0.1' | \
        bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps | \
        bcftools sort -O z -o $VCF90
bcftools index $VCF90

### Filter SNPs for depth, completeness (50%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools view -e 'FORMAT/DP > 72' $AD_CLEAN | \
        bcftools view -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' | \
        bcftools view -e 'F_MISSING > 0.5' | \
        bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps | \
        bcftools sort -O z -o $AD50
bcftools index $AD50

### Filter SNPs for depth, completeness (90%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools view -e 'FORMAT/DP > 72' $AD_CLEAN | \
        bcftools view -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' | \
        bcftools view -e 'F_MISSING > 0.1' | \
        bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps | \
        bcftools sort -O z -o $AD90
bcftools index $AD90
```

## Entire *A. distichus* species group -- 50% complete
```{r, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 15}
library(vcfR)
library(adegenet)

vcf50 <- read.vcfR("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/pop-gen/all_males_y_scaffolds_50miss.vcf.gz")

popmap <- popmap %>% filter(specimen_path %in% colnames(vcf50@gt)[2:ncol(vcf50@gt)])

gen50 <- vcfR2genlight(vcf50)
popmap$specimen_path == gen50@ind.names

pca50 <- glPca(gen50, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE, nf = 4)
pve50 <- 100*pca50$eig/sum(pca50$eig)
pve50

df <- as_tibble(cbind(popmap, as.data.frame(pca50$scores)),
        col_names = c(colnames(popmap),
        paste0("PC", 1:(ncol(pca50$scores)-1))))

### PC1 vs PC2
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = population_post, label = specimen, shape = clade)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.95, size = 4, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, labels = col_labs,
        guide = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shps, labels = shp_labs, name = "Major Clades") +
    guides(alpha = "none", size = "none",
        fill  = guide_legend(
            title = "Taxon",
            label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"),
            override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4)),
        shape = guide_legend(
            title = "Major Clades",
            override.aes = list(size = 4, fill = "grey50"))) +
    labs(fill = "Taxon", x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve50[1], digits = 1), "% of variation)"),
        y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve50[2], digits = 1), "% of variation)")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 3),
        axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", family = "Helvetica", size = 16))

### PC2 vs PC3
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, fill = population_post, label = specimen, shape = clade)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.95, size = 4, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, labels = col_labs,
        guide = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shps, labels = shp_labs, name = "Major Clades") +
    guides(alpha = "none", size = "none",
        fill  = guide_legend(
            title = "Taxon",
            label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"),
            override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4)),
        shape = guide_legend(
            title = "Major Clades",
            override.aes = list(size = 4, fill = "grey50"))) +
    labs(fill = "Taxon", x = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve50[2], digits = 1), "% of variation)"),
        y = paste0("PC3 (", round(pve50[3], digits = 1), "% of variation)")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 3),
        axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", family = "Helvetica", size = 16))
```

```{r, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 15}
    geom_point(alpha = 0.95, size = 4, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, labels = col_labs,
        guide = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shps, labels = shp_labs, name = "Major Clades") +
    guides(alpha = "none", size = "none",
        fill  = guide_legend(
            title = "Taxon",
            label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"),
            override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4)),
        shape = guide_legend(
            title = "Major Clades",
            override.aes = list(size = 4, fill = "grey50"))) +
    labs(fill = "Taxon", x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve75[1], digits = 1), "% of variation)"),
        y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve75[2], digits = 1), "% of variation)")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 3),
        axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", family = "Helvetica", size = 16))

### PC2 vs PC3
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, fill = population_post, label = specimen, shape = clade)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.95, size = 4, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, labels = col_labs,
        guide = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shps, labels = shp_labs, name = "Major Clades") +
    guides(alpha = "none", size = "none",

        shape = guide_legend(

            override.aes = list(size = 4, fill = "grey50"))) +
```

## Pairwise Fst (50% complete *A. distichus* dataset)
```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8}
library(StAMPP)
library(reshape2)
library(viridis)

gen_ad50@pop <- as.factor(popmap$population_post)
fsts <- stamppFst(gen_ad50, nboots = 100, nclusters = 4, percent = 95)
str(fsts)
mat <- fsts$Fsts

### for the figure, use more descriptive names
new_order <- c("aurifer", "dom3", "suppar", "vinosus", "favillarum", "dom1", "dom4", "ravitergum",
            "west_ignigularis", "east_ignigularis", "properus", "sejunctus", "dom2",
            "biminiensis", "dapsilis", "distichoides", "distichus", "ocior"
            )

new_names <- c("A. d. aurifer", "A. d. dominicensis - SW", "A. d. suppar", "A. d. vinosus",
    "A. d. favillarum", "A. d. dominicensis - NW", "A. d. dominicensis - W", "A. d. ravitergum", 
    "A. d. ignigularis - W", "A. d. ignigularis - E",  "A. d. properus", "A. d. sejunctus", "A. d. dominicensis - E",
    "A. d. biminiensis", "A. d. dapsilis", "A. d. distichoides", "A. d. distichus", "A. d. ocior"
)

mat[upper.tri(mat)] <- t(mat)[upper.tri(mat)]

mat <- mat[new_order, new_order]
rownames(mat) <- new_names
colnames(mat) <- new_names

mat[lower.tri(mat)] <- NA
### Then plot
heatmap <- melt(mat)
ggplot(data = heatmap, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) + 
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 2), 
        color = ifelse(value > 0.5, "black", "white"))) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", na.value = "white", name = bquote(F[ST])) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_identity() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/ychrom-distichus50-fst-heatmap.pdf",
    width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

# Phylogeny of the Y

## Make "whitelist" of RAD loci
```{r, eval = TRUE}
## check out metadata
head(vcf_ad50@fix)

## isolate the third column, which contains the name of each locus
head(vcf_ad50@fix[,3])

## get list of just locus names to use as whitelist for stacks
loci50 <- sub(":.*", "", vcf_ad50@fix[,3])
## make sure the locus names look right
loci50[1:5]
whitelist <- unique(loci50)
whitelist

### write out whitelist for stacks
write.table(whitelist, file = "/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/y-chromosome-analysis/distichus_males_50complete_loci.txt",
    quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F)

loci75 <- sub(":.*", "", vcf_ad75@fix[,3])
## make sure the locus names look right
loci75[1:5]
whitelist <- unique(loci75)
whitelist

### write out whitelist for stacks
write.table(whitelist, file = "/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/y-chromosome-analysis/distichus_males_75complete_loci.txt",
    quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F)

loci90 <- sub(":.*", "", vcf_ad90@fix[,3])
## make sure the locus names look right
loci90[1:5]
whitelist <- unique(loci90)
whitelist

### write out whitelist for stacks
write.table(whitelist, file = "/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/y-chromosome-analysis/distichus_males_90complete_loci.txt",
    quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F)
```

## Write phylip-formatted file with concatenated Y chromosome RAD loci
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#! /usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=brev-stacks
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=10
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem=82gb
#SBATCH --time=48:00:00
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --error=err.yloci_%j
#SBATCH --output=out.yloci_%j

LIST=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/distichus_males_50complete_loci.txt
CAT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/gstacks/

### Make two column tab-delimited popmap for STACKS (specimen IDs repeated in both columns)
# awk -v "OFS=\t" '{print $1, $1}' filtered-distichus-males.txt > tmp && mv tmp filtered-distichus-males.txt
Y_POPMAP=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/filtered-distichus-males.txt
OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/phylo/y-chromosome
mkdir -p $OUT_DIR

### Run populations to get full RAD tags for white-listed loci on Y chromosome 
populations -P $CAT_DIR -M $Y_POPMAP -O $OUT_DIR -W $LIST -t 10 --max-obs-het 0.5 --min-samples-overall 0.5 --phylip-var-all --vcf-all
```

## Run `IQ-TREE2` to infer phylogeny from concatenated Y chromosome RAD loci
```{bash,eval=FALSE}
#! /usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --partition jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem 24G
#SBATCH --time 24:00:00
#SBATCH --ntasks 12
#SBATCH --output out.YconcatTree_%j
#SBATCH --error err.YconcatTree_%j

source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate phyloenv

MSA=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/phylo/y-chromosome/populations.all.phylip
# grep -v "^#" $MSA > tmp && mv tmp $MSA

OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/phylo/iq-tree/y_chromosome
mkdir -p $OUT_DIR

cd $OUT_DIR

### Run IQ-TREE2
iqtree -s $MSA -m MFP -B 1000 --alrt 1000 -st DNA -seed 1968 -nt AUTO --prefix y_distichus_50complete
```

```{r, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 30}
library(ape)
library(phangorn)
library(ggtree)
library(tidytree)
library(ggnewscale)
library(stringr)

popmap <- read_table("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/sampling-master-detailed.tsv")

popmap$population_post[popmap$population_post == "dom1"] <- "dominicensis_NW"
popmap$population_post[popmap$population_post == "dom2"] <- "dominicensis_E"
popmap$population_post[popmap$population_post == "dom3"] <- "dominicensis_SW"
popmap$population_post[popmap$population_post == "dom4"] <- "dominicensis_W"


tree <- read.tree("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/y-chromosome-analysis/phylo/iqtree/y_distichus_50complete.treefile")
tree$tip.label <- str_split(tree$tip.label, pattern = "\\.", simplify = T)[,1]
tree$tip.label %in% popmap$specimen

popmap <- popmap %>% filter(specimen %in% tree$tip.label) %>%
        arrange(match(specimen, tree$tip.label))
popmap$specimen == tree$tip.label

tree$tip.label <- paste(sep = "_", popmap$specimen, popmap$population_post, popmap$locality)

plot.phylo(tree)

tree2 <- midpoint(tree)
plot.phylo(tree2)
```

```{r, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 30}
cols <- setNames(c("#DB0CC4", # aurifer
        "#DBA163", # biminiensis
        "#662822", # distichoides
        "#7B3F8A", # distichus
        "#104728", # dapsilis
        "#D1C5AE", # ocior
        "#2E4766", # dom2
        "#BDA425", # properus

        "#87DB41", # sejunctus

        "#DB6E1B", # suppar
        "#DB8CA3" # vinosus
        ),
        unique(popmap$population_post)
)
col_labs <- unique(popmap$population_post)

popmap <- popmap %>% mutate(Color = cols[population_post],
                             tip_label = paste(specimen, population_post, locality, sep = "_"))
tip_colors <- popmap %>% select(tip_label, Color) %>% deframe()

# Parse the support values
parse_support <- function(label) {
  if (is.na(label) || label == "") return(c(NA, NA))
    parts <- strsplit(as.character(label), "/")[[1]]
    shalrt <- as.numeric(parts[1])
    ufboot <- as.numeric(parts[2])
    return(c(shalrt, ufboot))
}
# Extract UFboot and SH-aLRT values
support_values <- t(sapply(tree2$node.label, parse_support))
shalrt <- support_values[, 1]
ufboot <- support_values[, 2]

# Replace labels with NA where BOTH values exceed thresholds
tree2$node.label <- ifelse(shalrt >= 80 & ufboot >= 95, 
                           "supported", 
                           tree2$node.label)

popmap <- popmap %>% arrange(match(tip_label, tree2$tip.label))

p <- ggtree(tree2) +
        geom_tiplab(size = 4, family = "Helvetica", offset = 0.0001) +
        geom_point2(aes(subset = !isTip & label == "supported"),
                size  = 2,
                color = "black",
                shape = 16) + 
        geom_tippoint(aes(color = label), size = 5) +
        scale_color_manual(values = tip_colors) +
        theme(legend.position = "none",
                axis.line.x = element_blank(),
                axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
        hexpand(.3)
p

ggsave(filename = "~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/y-chromosome-distichus-males-50complete-tree.pdf",
        limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 300, width = 16, height = 30, units = "in")
```

## Calculate per-site mean depth for X chromosome scaffolds
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
awk '{print $1}' filtered-distichus-males.txt > samples-to-keep.txt
MALES=samples-to-keep.txt
X1_BED=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/x1-chrom-scaffolds.txt
X2_BED=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/x2-chrom-scaffolds.txt
VCF=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/populations.snps.sorted.vcf.gz

bcftools view -S $MALES --regions-file $X1_BED $VCF | \
    bcftools query -f '%CHROM\t%POS\t[%DP\t]\n' | \
    awk '{sum=0; n=0; for(i=3;i<=NF;i++) if($i!=".") {sum+=$i; n++} if(n>0) print $1"\t"$2"\t"sum/n"\t"n}' \
    > X1-per-site-mean-depth.txt

bcftools view -S $MALES --regions-file $X2_BED $VCF | \
    bcftools query -f '%CHROM\t%POS\t[%DP\t]\n' | \
    awk '{sum=0; n=0; for(i=3;i<=NF;i++) if($i!=".") {sum+=$i; n++} if(n>0) print $1"\t"$2"\t"sum/n"\t"n}' \
    > X2-per-site-mean-depth.txt
```

```{r}
x1 <- read_table("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/y-chromosome-analysis/x-chromosomes/X1-per-site-mean-depth.txt",
            col_names = c("scaffold", "position", "mean_depth", "sample_size"))

x2 <- read_table("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/y-chromosome-analysis/x-chromosomes/X2-per-site-mean-depth.txt",
            col_names = c("scaffold", "position", "mean_depth", "sample_size"))

quantile(x1$mean_depth)
quantile(x2$mean_depth)

x1_q3 <- quantile(x1$mean_depth, 0.75)
x2_q3 <- quantile(x2$mean_depth, 0.75)

x1[x1$mean_depth <= x1_q3*3,]
x2[x2$mean_depth <= x2_q3*3,]
```

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd

## Load conda env with bcftools
source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

VCF=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/populations.snps.sorted.vcf.gz
X1_CLEAN=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/x1_cleaned_distichus_only.vcf.gz
X2_CLEAN=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/x2_cleaned_distichus_only.vcf.gz
OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools
X1_BED=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/x1-chrom-scaffolds.txt
X2_BED=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/x2-chrom-scaffolds.txt
X1_50=${OUT_DIR}/distichus_x1_50miss.vcf.gz
X1_90=${OUT_DIR}/distichus_x1_10miss.vcf.gz
X2_50=${OUT_DIR}/distichus_x2_50miss.vcf.gz
X2_90=${OUT_DIR}/distichus_x2_10miss.vcf.gz

awk '{print $1}' filtered-distichus-males.txt > samples-to-keep.txt

bcftools view -S samples-to-keep.txt --regions-file $X1_BED $VCF | bgzip > $X1_CLEAN
bcftools index $X1_CLEAN

bcftools view -S samples-to-keep.txt --regions-file $X2_BED $VCF | bgzip > $X2_CLEAN
bcftools index $X2_CLEAN

### Filter SNPs for depth, completeness (50%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools view -e 'FORMAT/DP > 72' $X1_CLEAN | \
        bcftools view -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' | \
        bcftools view -e 'F_MISSING > 0.5' | \
        bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps | \
        bcftools sort -O z -o $X1_50
bcftools index $X1_50

### Filter SNPs for depth, completeness (90%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools view -e 'FORMAT/DP > 72' $X1_CLEAN | \
        bcftools view -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' | \
        bcftools view -e 'F_MISSING > 0.1' | \
        bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps | \
        bcftools sort -O z -o $X1_90
bcftools index $X1_90

### Filter SNPs for depth, completeness (50%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools view -e 'FORMAT/DP > 72' $X2_CLEAN | \
        bcftools view -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' | \
        bcftools view -e 'F_MISSING > 0.5' | \
        bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps | \
        bcftools sort -O z -o $X2_50
bcftools index $X2_50

### Filter SNPs for depth, completeness (90%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools view -e 'FORMAT/DP > 72' $X2_CLEAN | \
        bcftools view -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' | \
        bcftools view -e 'F_MISSING > 0.1' | \
        bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps | \
        bcftools sort -O z -o $X2_90
bcftools index $X2_90
```

No need for physical linkage filtering for the X chromosome scaffolds as we are interested in the overall phylogenetic signal of these linkage groups.

## Filter VCF to obtain loci for whitelist
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#! /usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --error=snpfilt_%j.err
#SBATCH --output=snpfilt_%j.out
#SBATCH --time=24:00:00
#SBATCH --job-name=autoFilter

## Load conda env with bcftools
source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

VCF=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/populations.snps.sorted.vcf.gz
AD_CLEAN=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/autosomes_cleaned_distichus_only.vcf.gz
OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools
SEX_BED=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/sex-chrom-scaffolds.txt
AD50=${OUT_DIR}/distichus_males_autosomes_50miss.vcf.gz
AD90=${OUT_DIR}/distichus_males_autosomes_10miss.vcf.gz

awk '{print $1}' filtered-distichus-males.txt > samples-to-keep.txt

### Drop specimens with >85% missing data in Y dataset
bcftools view -S samples-to-keep.txt --targets-file ^$SEX_BED $VCF -Oz -o $AD_CLEAN
bcftools index -t $AD_CLEAN

### Filter SNPs for depth, completeness (50%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools view -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' $AD_CLEAN | \
        bcftools view -e 'F_MISSING > 0.5' | \
        bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps | \
        bcftools sort -O z -o $AD50
bcftools index $AD50

### Filter SNPs for depth, completeness (90%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools view -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' $AD_CLEAN | \
        bcftools view -e 'F_MISSING > 0.1' | \
        bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps | \
        bcftools sort -O z -o $AD90
bcftools index $AD90

### Drop SNPs within 1 kb of each other
plink --vcf $AD50 --bp-space 1000 --allow-extra-chr --set-missing-var-ids @:# --make-bed --recode vcf --out $OUT_DIR/distichus_males_autosomes_LD_50miss
plink --vcf $AD90 --bp-space 1000 --allow-extra-chr --set-missing-var-ids @:# --make-bed --recode vcf --out $OUT_DIR/distichus_males_autosomes_LD_10miss

rm samples-to-keep.txt
```

## Use `populations` to get full ddRAD loci for whitelist
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=brev-stacks
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=10
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem=36gb
#SBATCH --time=24:00:00
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --error=err.autloci_%j
#SBATCH --output=out.autloci_%j

source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

Y_POPMAP=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/filtered-distichus-males.txt
CAT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/gstacks/
OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/phylo/male-autosomes
LIST=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/distichus_males_autosomes_10miss_loci.txt

### Run populations to get full RAD tags for subset of males used for Y chromosome analysis
populations -P $CAT_DIR -M $Y_POPMAP -O $OUT_DIR -W $LIST -t 10 --max-obs-het 0.5 --min-samples-overall 0.5 --phylip-var-all --vcf-all
```

## Run IQ-TREE2 to generate a maximum likelihood tree for the concatenated autosomal ddRAD loci
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#! /usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --partition jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem 96G
#SBATCH --time 4-12:00:00
#SBATCH --ntasks 12
#SBATCH --output out.autoconcatTree_%j
#SBATCH --error err.autoconcatTree_%j

source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate phyloenv

MSA=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/phylo/male-autosomes/populations.all.phylip
# grep -v "^#" $MSA > tmp && mv tmp $MSA

OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/phylo/iq-tree/male-autosomes
mkdir -p $OUT_DIR

cd $OUT_DIR

### Run IQ-TREE2
iqtree -s $MSA -m MFP -B 1000 --alrt 1000 -st DNA -seed 1968 -nt AUTO --prefix distichus_male_90complete_autosomes
```
